summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests a combination of 5-fluorouracil (5-FU), oxaliplatin, and liposomal irinotecan (nal-IRI) with immunotherapy, plus trastuzumab for HER2-positive tumors, in advanced esophageal or gastric adenocarcinoma. The drugs are given by intravenous infusion on day 1 and day 15 of each cycle, and cycles last 28 days (42 days in one cohort). The record does not state a primary outcome; it describes evaluating efficacy and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa una combinación de 5-fluorouracilo (5-FU), oxaliplatino e irinotecán liposomal (nal-IRI) con inmunoterapia, más trastuzumab en tumores HER2 positivos, en adenocarcinoma avanzado de esófago o estómago. Los medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa el día 1 y el día 15 de cada ciclo, y los ciclos duran 28 días (42 días en una cohorte). El registro no indica un resultado principal; describe la evaluación de la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 2
Locally advanced or metastatic esophageal or gastric adenocarcinoma confirmed by biopsy or cytology
HER2 status and PD-L1 CPS status must be known before treatment
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and no prior systemic therapy for advanced disease
Age 18 years or older with adequate organ function
not_for: Known hypersensitivity to 5-FU, oxaliplatin, platinum agents, or liposomal product components
Other active malignancy requiring treatment within the last 2 years
Current therapy with another investigational agent
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis, or known HIV
